PM Narendra Modi marks 25 years in executive office

Prime Minister Narendra Modi marked 25 years in executive office, a span that includes his tenure as Gujarat’s chief minister and his time as India’s prime minister. Party leaders such as BJP president Nitin Nirav and Home Minister Amit Shah congratulated him, describing the milestone as a record of public service and a lasting political imprint. Modi thanked citizens for their support and recounted a school‑time anecdote while acknowledging the achievement.
